purpose: Expand the existing pooled model experiment to the eight configured Indian cities
selection_rule: lowest validation temperature RMSE; never reselect on 2025 test scores
parameter_policy: reuse two-city model parameters unchanged; no test-based hyperparameter tuning
prior_holdout_context: Pune and Mumbai 2025 scores were already observed in the earlier two-city experiment
numerical_remediation: The initial expanded run exposed history-length-dependent rolling-average roundoff during inference verification. All models were refitted using a 10-decimal canonical feature format; hyperparameters and partitions are unchanged. Initial eight-city test scores had already been observed before this numerical correction.
